description: This file defines functions, macros, and structures related to reverse index management for pack files in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for loading, verifying, and converting between different object position representations within pack and multi-pack index files.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Populates the revindex's internal data structures for a given pack, returning 0 on success or a negative value on failure.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Loads a pack revindex directly from disk, returning 0 on success, 1 if no .rev file exists, or -1 on parse error.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Verifies that the on-disk rev-index matches what would be generated from scratch, returning a negative number on error.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the '.rev' file for a multi-pack index by mmap-ing it, returning negative on error or positive if no reverse index exists.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack reverse index, returning negative on error.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts an object offset to a pack position, returning 0 on success and a negative number on failure.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position in constant time.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a byte offset within the pack.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position within a MIDX to a MIDX position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts from a MIDX-relative position to a pack position, running in O(log N).

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a pack ID and offset pair within a MIDX to a pack position.
